## Change

What concrete problem does this solve? Describe the before/after behavior and the scope of this PR. Link a related issue or roadmap task if there is one.

## Evidence

Give reproduction steps, checks actually run and their results. State any unavailable or failing checks. For an editing change, include the user action sequence and relevant cancel/undo/save behavior.

For physics or performance changes only: compare the same scene/settings, collision coverage, deformation and full-step cost. Include rest, sliding and pull/release where relevant; a quieter but stuck garment is not a pass. Report GPU use and distinguish rendering FPS from simulated/wall time. See the [benchmark contract](https://github.com/erythrofr/ClothCraft/blob/main/docs/solver-challenge.md).

## Limits

What remains unsupported or uncertain? Include sources/provenance for new algorithms, external code or fixtures. AI-assisted changes use the same review and evidence requirements; generated output is not validation.
